title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 16
paragraphs: After Ardys had reigned forty-nine years, his son Sadyattes succeeded him and reigned twelve years; and after him came Alyattes. This last made war on Cyaxares, the descendant of Deioces, and on the Medes, drove the Cimmerians out of Asia, captured Smyrna — which had been founded from Colophon — and launched an invasion against Clazomenae. From Clazomenae he returned not as he wished, but with heavy losses. During his reign, however, he accomplished other deeds very much worth recording, as follows:
